items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 May 2026 4:28pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 28 May 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the North Sea, moving southeast. Large and slow-moving area of low pressure in the mid-Atlantic.


##Wind##

South or southeast 4 or 5, veering south or southwest 5 or 6 this evening, decreasing 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, soon becoming mainly moderate, falling slight again later.


##Weather##

Mist and fog patches this evening and at first tonight, becoming fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor in mist and very poor in any fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, soon decreasing 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 again later.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain or drizzle later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle later.
